title: Non-Food and Industrial Crops: Volume of Production, by Region, Province, Quarter, and Semester, 2010-2026
official_note: Final data through Quarter 4, Semester 2, and Annual 2025; preliminary Quarter 1 2026.
gap_method: Unavailable cells are estimated from location-specific seasonal shares and annual interpolation/extrapolation. Estimated cells are tagged estimated_gap and are not represented as official observations.
